No green stamp in this static board. The implementation may stamp only after the real check passes.
MUST BE PROVEN IN CODE, NOT BY THIS BOARD
□ Stable tie-breaks and ranking edge cases
□ Reply guard and price-free serialized model requests
□ Timeout deadline, tool limits, fallback accounting
□ Ask/deal invariance and identical optimizer receipts
□ Four themes, Thai/English, keyboard, reduced motion, WCAG AA
Catalog, formatter, verifier, and optimizer own every fact.
